_comment: Project-scoped MCP server. Run "node bin/install.js" to generate a ready-to-use .mcp.json with the correct install path for this machine. Or copy this file to the WORKSPACE ROOT as .mcp.json and replace __INSTALL_DIR__ with your actual install path (e.g. $HOME/.claude/orchestrator on macOS/Linux, %USERPROFILE%/.claude/orchestrator on Windows). When the orchestrator source lives in the workspace itself, a relative "mcp-graph.js" works on every OS and stays committable.
_comment_auth: Optional: set ORCH_TOKEN to the same bearer token the daemon expects (env ORCH_TOKEN or <BASE>/token) so the proxy can call /mcp + write endpoints when auth is enabled. Leave unset when no token is configured (the default).

env._ORCH_TOKEN_hint: set ORCH_TOKEN here only if the daemon has auth enabled
